title: The Basics — squba_basics
text: cohort tabular input || required cohort used data quality testing. table contain, minimum: site | character | name(s) institutions included cohort person_id / patid | integer / character | patient identifier start_date | date | start cohort period end_date | date | end cohort period Note start end dates included table used limit search window analyses module. omop_or_pcornet string || required string, either omop pcornet, indicating CDM format data multi_or_single_site string || defaults single string, either single multi, indicating whether single-site multi-site analysis executed. selection applied across analyses executed kit. ca_input tabular input || required table CSV file attrition information site included cohort. table minimally contain: site | character | name institution step_number | integer | numeric identifier attrition step attrition_step | character | description attrition step num_pts | integer | patient count attrition step pf_input tabular input || required table defines fact domains investigated analysis. input contain: domain | character | string label domain examined (.e. prescription drugs) domain_tbl | character | CDM table information domain can found (.e. drug_exposure) filter_logic | character | logic applied domain_tbl order achieve definition interest; written applying dplyr::filter command R pf_visits tabular input || required table defines visit types interest called visit_types. input contain: visit_concept_id enc_type | integer character | visit_concept_id enc_type represents visit type interest (.e. 9201 IP) visit_type | character | string label describe visit type information extracted either visit_occurrence (OMOP) encounter (PCORnet) CDM tables. wish extract visit information tables, please run Patient Facts module . evp_input tabular input || required table information variables examined analysis. table contain following columns: variable | character | string label variable captured associated codeset domain_tbl | character | CDM table variable found concept_field | character | string name field domain table concepts located date_field | character | name field domain table date used temporal filtering vocabulary_field | character | PCORnet applications, name field domain table vocabulary identifier differentiate concepts one another (ex: dx_type); can set NA OMOP applications codeset_name | character | name codeset defines variable interest filter_logic | character | logic applied domain_tbl order achieve definition interest; written applying dplyr::filter command R see example structure file, please see ?expectedvariablespresent::evp_variable_file_omop ?expectedvariablespresent::evp_variable_file_pcornet evp_variable_filter string vector || required longitudinal analysis, HIGHLY RECOMMEND choosing 3 variables analysis executed. recommended order keep runtime low. function error choose select 3 variables, please know take longer process. time_period string || defaults year string indicating distance dates within specified time_span. Defaults year, time periods month week also acceptable time_span vector - length 2 || defaults c('2015-01-01', '2020-01-01') vector indicating lower upper bounds time series longitudinal analyses
